Plandex Cloud
Overview​
INFO

Plandex Cloud is winding down as of 10/3/2025 and is no longer accepting new users. Learn more.

Plandex Cloud is the easiest and most reliable way to use Plandex. You'll be prompted to start a trial when you launch the REPL with plandex or create your first plan with plandex new.

Billing Modes​

Plandex Cloud has two billing modes:

Integrated Models​
Use Plandex credits to pay for AI models.
No separate accounts or API keys are required.
Credits are deducted at the model's price from the provider plus a small markup to cover credit card processing costs.
Start with a $10 trial (includes $10 in credits).
After the trial, you can upgrade to a paid plan for $45 per month—includes $20 in credits every month that never expire.

Get started with Integrated Models Mode.

BYO API Key​
Use your own model provider accounts and API keys.
Start with a free trial up to 10 plans and 20 model responses per plan.
After the trial, you can upgrade to a paid plan for $30 per month.

Get started with BYO API Key Mode.

Billing Settings​

Run plandex billing in the terminal to bring up the billing settings page in your default browser, or go to your Billing Settings page (sign in if necessary).

Here you can switch billing modes, view your current plan, manage your billing details, pause or cancel your subscription and more.

Integrated Models Mode​

If you're using Integrated Models Mode, you can use the billing settings page to view your credits balance, purchase credits, and configure auto-recharge settings to automatically add credits to your account when your balance gets too low. You can also set a monthly budget and an email notification threshold.

usage command​

You can see your current balance and a report on recent usage with plandex usage (\usage in the REPL):

plandex usage


You can see a log of individual transactions that includes every model call with plandex usage --log:

plandex usage --log


In the Plandex REPL, usage defaults to showing usage for the current REPL session. Otherwise, it defaults to showing usage for the day so far.

You can use the --today flag to show usage for the day so far. You can use the --month flag to show usage for the current billing month. You can use the --plan flag to show usage for the current plan.

plandex usage --today # show usage for the day so far
plandex usage --month # show usage for the current billing month
plandex usage --plan # show usage for the current plan


You can use the --debits flag to show only debits in the log. You can use the --purchases flag to show only purchases in the log.

plandex usage --log --debits --month # show only debits for the current billing month
plandex usage --log --purchases --today # show only purchases for the day so far

Privacy / Data Retention​

Data you send to Plandex Cloud is retained in order to debug and improve Plandex. In the future, this data may also be used to train and fine-tune models to improve performance and reduce costs.

That said, if you delete your Plandex Cloud account, all associated data will be removed within 14 days (this delay allows for debugging and backups).

Data sent to Plandex Cloud may be shared with the following third parties:

OpenAI for OpenAI models when using Integrated Models Mode.
OpenRouter.ai for Anthropic, Google, and other non-OpenAI models when using Integrated Models Mode.
Google Vertex AI for Google and Anthropic models when using Integrated Models Mode.
AWS for hosting and database services. Data is encrypted in transit and at rest.
Your name and email is shared with Loops, an email marketing service, in order to send you updates on Plandex. You can opt out of these emails at any time with one click.
Your name and email are shared with our payment processor Stripe if you subscribe to a paid plan or purchase the $10 trial.
Basic usage data is sent to Google Analytics to help track usage and make improvements.
Relace for an instant apply AI model that speeds up and reduces the cost of file edits. Used as a fallback if Plandex is unable to apply edits deterministically. Inputs are the original file and the edit snippet from a Plandex response.
Rollbar for error tracking and alerting. It's unlikely that any user data would be shared with Rollbar. If it was, it would be minimal and incidental to error reporting.

Apart from the above list, no other data will be shared with any other third party. The list will be updated if any new third party services are introduced.

Data sent to a model provider like OpenAI or OpenRouter.ai is subject to the model provider's privacy and data retention policies.

See our full Privacy Policy for more details.

<p>Plandex Cloud is the easiest and most reliable way to use Plandex. You'll be prompted to start a trial when you launch the <a href="/repl">REPL</a> with <code>plandex</code> or create your first plan with <code>plandex new</code>.</p>
<h2 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="billing-modes">Billing Modes<a class="hash-link" aria-label="Direct link to Billing Modes" title="Direct link to Billing Modes" href="/hosting/cloud#billing-modes">​</a></h2>
<p>Plandex Cloud has two billing modes:</p>
<h3 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="integrated-models">Integrated Models<a class="hash-link" aria-label="Direct link to Integrated Models" title="Direct link to Integrated Models" href="/hosting/cloud#integrated-models">​</a></h3>
<ul>
<li>Use Plandex credits to pay for AI models.</li>
<li>No separate accounts or API keys are required.</li>
<li>Credits are deducted at the model's price from the provider plus a small markup to cover credit card processing costs.</li>
<li>Start with a $10 trial (includes $10 in credits).</li>
<li>After the trial, you can upgrade to a paid plan for $45 per month—includes $20 in credits every month that never expire.</li>
</ul>
<p><a href="https://app.plandex.ai/start?modelsMode=integrated" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Get started with Integrated Models Mode.</a></p>
<h3 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="byo-api-key">BYO API Key<a class="hash-link" aria-label="Direct link to BYO API Key" title="Direct link to BYO API Key" href="/hosting/cloud#byo-api-key">​</a></h3>
<ul>
<li>Use your own model provider accounts and API keys.</li>
<li>Start with a free trial up to 10 plans and 20 model responses per plan.</li>
<li>After the trial, you can upgrade to a paid plan for $30 per month.</li>
</ul>
<p><a href="https://app.plandex.ai/start?modelsMode=byo" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Get started with BYO API Key Mode.</a></p>
<h2 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="billing-settings">Billing Settings<a class="hash-link" aria-label="Direct link to Billing Settings" title="Direct link to Billing Settings" href="/hosting/cloud#billing-settings">​</a></h2>
<p>Run <code>plandex billing</code> in the terminal to bring up the billing settings page in your default browser, or go to <a href="https://app.plandex.ai/settings/billing" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">your Billing Settings page</a> (sign in if necessary).</p>
<p>Here you can switch billing modes, view your current plan, manage your billing details, pause or cancel your subscription and more.</p>
<h3 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="integrated-models-mode">Integrated Models Mode<a class="hash-link" aria-label="Direct link to Integrated Models Mode" title="Direct link to Integrated Models Mode" href="/hosting/cloud#integrated-models-mode">​</a></h3>
<p>If you're using <strong>Integrated Models Mode</strong>, you can use the billing settings page to view your credits balance, purchase credits, and configure auto-recharge settings to automatically add credits to your account when your balance gets too low. You can also set a monthly budget and an email notification threshold.</p>
<h3 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="usage-command"><code>usage</code> command<a class="hash-link" aria-label="Direct link to usage-command" title="Direct link to usage-command" href="/hosting/cloud#usage-command">​</a></h3>
<p>You can see your current balance and a report on recent usage with <code>plandex usage</code> (<code>\usage</code> in the REPL):</p>
<div class="language-bash codeBlockContainer_Ckt0 theme-code-block" style="--prism-color: #F8F8F2; --prism-background-color: #282A36;"><div class="codeBlockContent_biex"><pre tabindex="0" class="prism-code language-bash codeBlock_bY9V thin-scrollbar" style="color: rgb(248, 248, 242); background-color: rgb(40, 42, 54);"><code class="codeBlockLines_e6Vv"><span class="token-line" style="color: rgb(248, 248, 242);"><span class="token plain">plandex usage</span><br></span></code></pre><div class="buttonGroup__atx"><button type="button" aria-label="Copy code to clipboard" title="Copy" class="clean-btn"><span class="copyButtonIcons_eSgA" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" class="copyButtonIcon_y97N"><path fill="currentColor" d="M19,21H8V7H19M19,5H8A2,2 0 0,0 6,7V21A2,2 0 0,0 8,23H19A2,2 0 0,0 21,21V7A2,2 0 0,0 19,5M16,1H4A2,2 0 0,0 2,3V17H4V3H16V1Z"></path></svg><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" class="copyButtonSuccessIcon_LjdS"><path fill="currentColor" d="M21,7L9,19L3.5,13.5L4.91,12.09L9,16.17L19.59,5.59L21,7Z"></path></svg></span></button></div></div></div>
<p>You can see a log of individual transactions that includes every model call with <code>plandex usage --log</code>:</p>
<div class="language-bash codeBlockContainer_Ckt0 theme-code-block" style="--prism-color: #F8F8F2; --prism-background-color: #282A36;"><div class="codeBlockContent_biex"><pre tabindex="0" class="prism-code language-bash codeBlock_bY9V thin-scrollbar" style="color: rgb(248, 248, 242); background-color: rgb(40, 42, 54);"><code class="codeBlockLines_e6Vv"><span class="token-line" style="color: rgb(248, 248, 242);"><span class="token plain">plandex usage --log</span><br></span></code></pre><div class="buttonGroup__atx"><button type="button" aria-label="Copy code to clipboard" title="Copy" class="clean-btn"><span class="copyButtonIcons_eSgA" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" class="copyButtonIcon_y97N"><path fill="currentColor" d="M19,21H8V7H19M19,5H8A2,2 0 0,0 6,7V21A2,2 0 0,0 8,23H19A2,2 0 0,0 21,21V7A2,2 0 0,0 19,5M16,1H4A2,2 0 0,0 2,3V17H4V3H16V1Z"></path></svg><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" class="copyButtonSuccessIcon_LjdS"><path fill="currentColor" d="M21,7L9,19L3.5,13.5L4.91,12.09L9,16.17L19.59,5.59L21,7Z"></path></svg></span></button></div></div></div>
<p>In the Plandex REPL, <code>usage</code> defaults to showing usage for the current REPL session. Otherwise, it defaults to showing usage for the day so far.</p>
<p>You can use the <code>--today</code> flag to show usage for the day so far. You can use the <code>--month</code> flag to show usage for the current billing month. You can use the <code>--plan</code> flag to show usage for the current plan.</p>
<div class="language-bash codeBlockContainer_Ckt0 theme-code-block" style="--prism-color: #F8F8F2; --prism-background-color: #282A36;"><div class="codeBlockContent_biex"><pre tabindex="0" class="prism-code language-bash codeBlock_bY9V thin-scrollbar" style="color: rgb(248, 248, 242); background-color: rgb(40, 42, 54);"><code class="codeBlockLines_e6Vv"><span class="token-line" style="color: rgb(248, 248, 242);"><span class="token plain">plandex usage --today # show usage for the day so far</span><br></span><span class="token-line" style="color: rgb(248, 248, 242);"><span class="token plain">plandex usage --month # show usage for the current billing month</span><br></span><span class="token-line" style="color: rgb(248, 248, 242);"><span class="token plain">plandex usage --plan # show usage for the current plan</span><br></span></code></pre><div class="buttonGroup__atx"><button type="button" aria-label="Copy code to clipboard" title="Copy" class="clean-btn"><span class="copyButtonIcons_eSgA" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" class="copyButtonIcon_y97N"><path fill="currentColor" d="M19,21H8V7H19M19,5H8A2,2 0 0,0 6,7V21A2,2 0 0,0 8,23H19A2,2 0 0,0 21,21V7A2,2 0 0,0 19,5M16,1H4A2,2 0 0,0 2,3V17H4V3H16V1Z"></path></svg><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" class="copyButtonSuccessIcon_LjdS"><path fill="currentColor" d="M21,7L9,19L3.5,13.5L4.91,12.09L9,16.17L19.59,5.59L21,7Z"></path></svg></span></button></div></div></div>
<p>You can use the <code>--debits</code> flag to show only debits in the log. You can use the <code>--purchases</code> flag to show only purchases in the log.</p>
<div class="language-bash codeBlockContainer_Ckt0 theme-code-block" style="--prism-color: #F8F8F2; --prism-background-color: #282A36;"><div class="codeBlockContent_biex"><pre tabindex="0" class="prism-code language-bash codeBlock_bY9V thin-scrollbar" style="color: rgb(248, 248, 242); background-color: rgb(40, 42, 54);"><code class="codeBlockLines_e6Vv"><span class="token-line" style="color: rgb(248, 248, 242);"><span class="token plain">plandex usage --log --debits --month # show only debits for the current billing month</span><br></span><span class="token-line" style="color: rgb(248, 248, 242);"><span class="token plain">plandex usage --log --purchases --today # show only purchases for the day so far</span><br></span></code></pre><div class="buttonGroup__atx"><button type="button" class="clean-btn" aria-label="Toggle word wrap" title="Toggle word wrap"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" class="wordWrapButtonIcon_Bwma" aria-hidden="true"><path fill="currentColor" d="M4 19h6v-2H4v2zM20 5H4v2h16V5zm-3 6H4v2h13.25c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2s-.9 2-2 2H15v-2l-3 3l3 3v-2h2c2.21 0 4-1.79 4-4s-1.79-4-4-4z"></path></svg></button><button type="button" aria-label="Copy code to clipboard" title="Copy" class="clean-btn"><span class="copyButtonIcons_eSgA" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" class="copyButtonIcon_y97N"><path fill="currentColor" d="M19,21H8V7H19M19,5H8A2,2 0 0,0 6,7V21A2,2 0 0,0 8,23H19A2,2 0 0,0 21,21V7A2,2 0 0,0 19,5M16,1H4A2,2 0 0,0 2,3V17H4V3H16V1Z"></path></svg><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" class="copyButtonSuccessIcon_LjdS"><path fill="currentColor" d="M21,7L9,19L3.5,13.5L4.91,12.09L9,16.17L19.59,5.59L21,7Z"></path></svg></span></button></div></div></div>
<h2 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="privacy--data-retention">Privacy / Data Retention<a class="hash-link" aria-label="Direct link to Privacy / Data Retention" title="Direct link to Privacy / Data Retention" href="/hosting/cloud#privacy--data-retention">​</a></h2>
<p>Data you send to Plandex Cloud is retained in order to debug and improve Plandex. In the future, this data may also be used to train and fine-tune models to improve performance and reduce costs.</p>
<p>That said, if you delete your Plandex Cloud account, all associated data will be removed within 14 days (this delay allows for debugging and backups).</p>
<p>Data sent to Plandex Cloud may be shared with the following third parties:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://openai.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">OpenAI</a> for OpenAI models when using Integrated Models Mode.</li>
<li><a href="https://openrouter.ai/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">OpenRouter.ai</a> for Anthropic, Google, and other non-OpenAI models when using Integrated Models Mode.</li>
<li><a href="https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Google Vertex AI</a> for Google and Anthropic models when using Integrated Models Mode.</li>
<li><a href="https://aws.amazon.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">AWS</a> for hosting and database services. Data is encrypted in transit and at rest.</li>
<li>Your name and email is shared with <a href="https://loops.so/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Loops</a>, an email marketing service, in order to send you updates on Plandex. You can opt out of these emails at any time with one click.</li>
<li>Your name and email are shared with our payment processor <a href="https://stripe.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Stripe</a> if you subscribe to a paid plan or purchase the $10 trial.</li>
<li>Basic usage data is sent to <a href="https://analytics.google.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Google Analytics</a> to help track usage and make improvements.</li>
<li><a href="https://relace.ai/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Relace</a> for an instant apply AI model that speeds up and reduces the cost of file edits. Used as a fallback if Plandex is unable to apply edits deterministically. Inputs are the original file and the edit snippet from a Plandex response.</li>
<li><a href="https://rollbar.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Rollbar</a> for error tracking and alerting. It's unlikely that any user data would be shared with Rollbar. If it was, it would be minimal and incidental to error reporting.</li>
</ul>
<p>Apart from the above list, no other data will be shared with any other third party. The list will be updated if any new third party services are introduced.</p>
<p>Data sent to a model provider like OpenAI or OpenRouter.ai is subject to the model provider's privacy and data retention policies.</p>
